anomalies.detail: Whitespace, form-feed characters, zero-width characters, and obvious mixed-script confusables were normalized during ingestion.

Questions 6-15 in Structure completion were partially corrupted in the DOCX extraction. Canonical content for Q6-Q15 was normalized from user-provided source corrections where the intended wording and choices were explicit.

Part C contained OCR artifacts in choices for questions 42, 43, 44, 45, 46, 48, and 50, including stray punctuation, missing initial letters, and missing spaces. Clear non-substantive text artifacts were normalized in canonical content.

note: Anomalies record source problems or deliberate normalization decisions. Canonical files should stay close to the DOCX while avoiding silent guessing.
